answer.justification: All logit-level values fall in the system-prompted range and outside the others. Top-1 agreement is 0.883 (system-prompted 0.861-0.908; fine-tuned is at most 0.938). Sequence agreement is 0.375 (0.31-0.48). KL is 0.265 (0.197-0.339), above the fine-tuned maximum of 0.205. TV is 0.123 (0.108-0.144), above the fine-tuned maximum of 0.099. Token-DiFR gap is 0.419 (0.28-0.52). Raw-score shift/TV is 3.6, which fits system-prompted (3.3-3.9) and is lower than the quantized-like 2.2-2.3 only in the other direction. Quantized is ruled out by the far larger KL and TV. Base is ruled out because every difference is non-zero. Fine-tuned is the closest alternative, but KL, TV and DiFR all exceed its ranges. Output and activation levels were not measured.
